chunks: And al-Ridha, peace be upon him, said:
It is appropriate for a man not to neglect applying some fragrance every day; if he cannot, then every other day; and if he cannot, then on every Jumu'ah he should not neglect that.
ai.seo_question: How often should a person use fragrance according to Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages regular use of fragrance as part of personal refinement and dignified conduct. It sets a graduated practice: daily if possible, otherwise every other day, and at minimum on Jumu'ah.
